verdict.rationale: Fathom's pricing page explicitly lists 'search across calls', which is a first-party cross-meeting search capability. Nothing documents what that search covers or whether results link to a timestamp. Keyword alerts and topic monitoring are adjacent features and earn no credit here. missing for 10: documented scope of search across transcripts, summaries and notes; jump-to-exact-moment or timestamp navigation from results; in-depth search docs; independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a product manager, I can search across every past meeting — transcripts, summaries, and notes — and jump to the exact moment something was said
